turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, how's your day been so far?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm hosting a game night Friday. There'll be six of us, and two have never really played board games.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun! Do you want one easy party game everyone can join, or two smaller groups playing different games?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me a minute, my friend just walked in. Don't say anything until I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Omar, what's that thing you ordered last time? The cold one?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Cold brew with oat milk. It's really smooth.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Is it strong? I don't want to be awake all night.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Pretty strong. Maybe get a small one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I'll just have a tea and steal a sip of yours.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: One sip. I know what you're like.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, where did we put the remote?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, I'm back now. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. We were planning your game night for six.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Two groups. My usual crowd will want something heavier.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Makes sense. Give the newcomers a simple card game and let the others tackle the long strategy one.
